metadata.title: Preliminary Summary of Harmonic Readout and c=1 Area Sweep in an AB Two-Body Closed Phase System
metadata.description: This release publishes a preliminary summary of six AB two-body closed phase system experiments. The experiments show that acceleration-like harmonic readout can be constructed from the label-free two-body relation f_AB without introducing external standard forces, individual forces f_A/f_B, or a background space. They also show that the AB two-body system alone lacks an independent gauge for deciding whether the acceleration-like readout follows proportional, inverse, or inverse-square dependence on position phase difference. Internal c=1 calibration and chi-tau area readout can be established, but native inverse-area scaling was not detected.
metadata.notes: This paper does not claim a derivation of standard gravity or a native inverse-square law. Its scope is the AB two-body closed phase system: acceleration-like harmonic readout is constructible, while distance-exponent readout remains indeterminate without an independent gauge.

title: Preliminary Summary of Harmonic Readout and c=1 Area Sweep in an AB Two-Body Closed Phase System
